parts.stem: Order the steps that describe the role of scavengers in environmental balance.

items.value: Scavengers such as bacteria decay the dead bodies.
Chemical elements from the decayed bodies go back to the environment.
Elements are recycled as they are used by other organisms.

correct_answer: Scavengers such as bacteria decay the dead bodies.
